rationale: QQQ is the purest CPI-beta instrument and CPI is tomorrow 8:30am ET - the dominant binary. Price is deeply oversold (RSI 23.4, %B 0.05, stoch 18) yet only -0.79% from VWAP, so it is neither extended enough vs VWAP to fade cleanly nor showing exhaustion to short into; positioning is balanced (L/S 1.02, no funding) so there is no crowd to squeeze either direction. Sitting flat and letting the print resolve is the highest-expectancy choice; want confirmation before committing risk.
